name: Artworks Local Art & Gifts
subtitle: Fine art, thoughtfully curated gifts, and the artists who inspire us
description: Artworks Pensacola brings together two distinct galleries under one creative vision. Each location offers its own unique experience, while sharing a commitment to fine art, thoughtfully curated gifts, and the artists who inspire us. Whether you visit one gallery or both, you'll find the same passion for quality, creativity, and meaningful connections to art—just expressed in two different spaces. We as artists have a love affair with our natural environment. Our eyes capture the beauty of the world around us. Help us to help the animals that need us to survive. 100% of all proceeds will be donated to the Wildlife Sanctuary of Northwest Florida.
